script.speaker: staff
script.text: The volunteer programme takes eight students this term. We had forty applications.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Do you choose the ones with the best grades?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Grades help, but we mostly look at whether you can come every week for a whole term.

script.speaker: student
script.text: So somebody with average grades and a free Wednesday has a real chance?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: That person often has a better chance than a busy top student.

question.stem: What does the staff member suggest about the selection?

options.A: Only the students with the highest grades are taken
options.B: Being there every week counts for more than high grades
options.D: Students must be free every day of the week
options.E: Grades are not looked at at all

question.explain_tr: Görevli notların yardımcı olduğunu ama asıl ölçütün her hafta düzenli gelebilmek olduğunu söylüyor. Notlara hiç bakılmadığı söylenmiyor.
question.key_line: That person often has a better chance than a busy top student.
